parole.testo: Borrowed from Polish rynek, ultimately from Proto-Germanic *hringaz (“ring”). Further from Proto-Indo-European *(s)krengʰ- (“ring, circle”) (akin to Proto-Indo-European *krongʰ-o-, whence Proto-Slavic *krǫgъ, whence Russian круг (krug)), possibly from Proto-Indo-European *(s)ker-.
